mg-comet-ev.author: Saiphani02
mg-comet-ev.alt: MG Comet EV in white with black roof, side profile
mg-comet-ev.note: Indian MG Comet EV at an MG showroom in India: two-door tall-boy body with MG badges (not the Wuling Air EV it is based on). No usable front three-quarter photo exists, so the side view is first.

mg-comet-ev.author: Saiphani02
mg-comet-ev.alt: MG Comet EV in white, rear view
mg-comet-ev.note: Same Indian showroom: MG badge and COMET lettering on the tailgate, Andhra Pradesh trade plate.

mg-comet-ev.author: Saiphani02
mg-comet-ev.alt: MG Comet EV dashboard with twin screens, right-hand drive
mg-comet-ev.note: Right-hand-drive Indian Comet EV cabin with MG-badged steering wheel and twin 10.25-inch screen panel.

mg-zs-ev.author: Oleg Yunakov
mg-zs-ev.alt: MG ZS EV (2022 facelift) in black, front three-quarter view
mg-zs-ev.note: Indian ZS EV on a Kerala green EV plate: facelift closed grille with textured panel and MG logo charging flap.

mg-zs-ev.file: File:2023 MG ZS EV AZS1 Essence rear.jpg
mg-zs-ev.author: LuvsMG481
mg-zs-ev.alt: MG ZS EV (facelift) in white, rear three-quarter view
mg-zs-ev.note: Australian-market ZS EV facelift (right-hand drive), visually the same as the Indian facelift: LED tail lamps and ZS EV badging.

mg-zs-ev.file: File:2023 MG ZS EV AZS1 Essence front.jpg
mg-zs-ev.author: LuvsMG481
mg-zs-ev.alt: MG ZS EV (facelift) in white, front three-quarter view
mg-zs-ev.note: Same Australian facelift car, identical to the Indian ZS EV design. Second front view because no side view or interior photo of the Indian car was available.

mg-astor.author: DriveSpark
mg-astor.alt: MG Astor in white, front three-quarter view
mg-astor.note: Indian MG Astor: Celestial grille with chrome studs and ASTOR placard. The Astor has not been facelifted in India, so the launch design is current.

mg-astor.file: File:2021 MG Astor Sharp 220 Turbo (India) rear view.png
mg-astor.author: DriveSpark
mg-astor.alt: MG Astor in white, rear three-quarter view
mg-astor.note: Same Indian car: ASTOR lettering on the tailgate. The 220 Turbo engine has since been dropped but the body is unchanged.

mg-cyberster.author: MrWalkr
mg-cyberster.alt: MG Cyberster in silver, front three-quarter view
mg-cyberster.note: UK-registered right-hand-drive Cyberster; India gets the same car as a CBU through MG Select, so the design is identical.

mg-cyberster.author: MrWalkr
mg-cyberster.alt: MG Cyberster in silver, rear three-quarter view
mg-cyberster.note: Same UK car: arrow-shaped LED tail lamps; CBU design identical to the Indian car.

mg-cyberster.author: Alexander Migl
mg-cyberster.alt: MG Cyberster in yellow, front three-quarter view
mg-cyberster.note: European Cyberster in yellow (a colour offered in India), roof up while charging. Second front view because no clean side view or right-hand-drive interior photo was available.

mg-m9.author: Ethan Llamas
mg-m9.alt: MG M9 (Mifa 9) electric MPV in wine red, front three-quarter view
mg-m9.note: Philippine-market MG Mifa 9 EV: the MG-badged electric MPV that MG sells in India and Europe as the M9, with the same lamps and body as the Singapore 'MG M9 EV' showcar. Not the Maxus-badged version.

mg-m9.file: File:(SGP-Singapore) Showcar MG M9 EV No-plate rear 2024-09-14 - 1.jpg
mg-m9.author: S5A-0043
mg-m9.alt: MG M9 EV in white, rear three-quarter view
mg-m9.note: Singapore 'All-New MG M9 EV' showroom car: M9 EV badge and full-width tail lamps, as on the Indian M9.
